title: Uno-Orchestra: Parsimonious Agent Routing via Selective Delegation
use_en: Selective decomposition and budget-aware delegation; their learned policy is not reproduced here.
use_es: Descomposición selectiva y delegación sensible al presupuesto; aquí no se reproduce su política aprendida.

title: ProgRouter: Online Progress-Guided Orchestration for Multi-Agent LLM Workflows under Quality-Cost Tradeoffs
authors: Songyuan Li, Ahmed M. Abdelmoniem and Shiqiang Wang
use_en: Progress-guided routing under cost/time constraints; our fixed gate is not its trained progress predictor or heterogeneous routing.
use_es: Enrutamiento por progreso bajo restricciones de tiempo/coste; nuestra compuerta fija no reproduce su predictor entrenado ni su selección entre modelos.

title: TROVE: Adaptive Agent Skill Orchestration via Trace-Grounded Route Validation and Editing
authors: Tianxing Wang, Mingming Zhao, Shuai Huang, Huiyang Xu, Chaoyue Niu, Shengzhong Liu and Fan Wu
use_en: Outcome-dependent continuation and local route repair; no offline learned skill graph is implemented in SAGE-CREH.
use_es: Continuación condicionada al resultado y reparación local de rutas; SAGE-CREH no implementa su grafo de skills aprendido offline.
